field_audits.exact_text:
InMotion (state:InMotion:line:11) is unreachable from root initial entry. The only path to InMotion is through DoorsClosing (transition:line:35), but DoorsClosing itself is unreachable. Verify-fact confirms reachability refuted.

Consequences observed in the same closed model (folded sub-claims, each an obligation settled by this root cause): (1) All event consumers within InMotion scope are unreachable; no operational event response is possible: All six declared events (including Closed_SendDeparted) have consumer transitions but zero reachable consumers.
